Read Me: DTM Sudan is a suite of methodological tools which aims to track and monitor internally displaced persons (IDPs) and returnees across Sudan. DTM collects primary data, with a focus on providing the best estimates for support of the wider humanitarian community.  Figures should be treated as preliminary findings and are subject to change via future verification exercises DTM may rely on remote interview with key informants in certain areas depending on insecurity. Data on flows into neighbouring countries is based on available information from DTM flow monitoring networks and secondary sources.

This tab provides the total information collected by field teams on displacement since 15 April 2023 at state level. It disaggregates data into states of origin and displacement. Figures for IDP individuals and households are providing at the state level. There is also some preliminary estimates on the disaggregation between Sudanese and Non-Sudanese nationals.
